name: formalization-improve
description: The formalization improver's automated loop (AGENTS.md "Formalization improvement"): the tier good proposes learned-layer wires (hints, examples, question texts as data, order and early exits of the problem questions) for one failure cluster of the regression baseline; checks.mjs validates them (allowed predicates, placeholders, protocol lint, no text copied from a case); the sink runs the regression gate on tier tiny and admits a change only if it fixes cases and loses none. Refusals and ESCALATE replies go to escalations.jsonl.
